div.head: Becw 3.1
div.ab: butan ðæt læste ða hwile ðe ic libbe; forðam ni[s æni m]an on life, ðe æfre gehyrde, ðæt man cwydde oððon crafode hine on hundrede oððon ahwar on gemote, on ceapstowe oþþe on cyricware, ða hwile þe he lifde: unsac he wæs on life; beo on legere, swa swa he mote!

except that it may last as long as I live. For there is no man alive who ever heard that it was claimed or craved in hundred or any other meeting, in market-place or church-congregation as long as he lived: uncontested he was in life, let him be so in his grave as he has every reason.

butan þæt læste ða hwile ðe ic libbe; forðam nis æt tinan on life, ðe æfre gehyrde, þæt man cwydde oððon crafode hine on hunræde oððon ahwar on gemote, on ceapstowe oðe on cyricware, ða hwile þe he lifede: unsac he wæs on life; beo on legere, swa swa he mote!

except that it may last as long as I live. For there is no man alive who ever heard that it was claimed or craved in hundred or any other meeting, in market-place or church-congregation as long as he lived: uncontested he was in life, let him be so in his grave as he has every reason.
